item.title: With a Super Bowl ad, California governor’s race 'is now kicked into gear’
item.description: Only one of the candidates for California governor will appear in a splashy Super Bowl ad on Sunday, though a rival has locked in a valuable spot on Animal Planet's lighthearted, cuddly "Puppy Bowl" before the big game.

item.title: AI’s latest 20-something billionaire got his start at L.A. garage sales
item.description: Meet the LA boy who turned a multi-millionaire starting an AI training company

item.title: Terrance Gore, former Dodgers player and three-time World Series champ, dies at 34
item.description: The baseball player's remarkable speed earned him spots on three championship teams, including the 2020 Dodgers.

item.title: A wolf has come to Los Angeles County for the first time in more than a century
item.description: Around 6 a.m. Saturday, the 3-year-old female arrived in the mountains north of Santa Clarita, as tracked by a GPS collar.

item.title: Second victim of 99 Ranch Market crash in Westwood identified
item.description: Authorities have released the identity of two victims of the 99 Ranch Market crash that occurred in Westwood on Thursday.

item.title: Savannah Guthrie's new plea to mother's kidnappers: 'We will pay' for her safe return
item.description: Investigators again scoured the desert brush outside the Tucson home of Nancy Guthrie, the mother of “Today” anchor Savannah Guthrie, as officials were reviewing a new message that could be tied to her abduction.

item.title: County Supervisor Lindsey Horvath won't run for L.A. mayor, ending weeks of speculation
item.description: Bass will still face challenges from reality TV star Spencer Pratt, democratic socialist Rae Huang, entrepreneur Adam Miller and potentially dozens of others.

item.title: Councilmember Nithya Raman to run for L.A. mayor, challenging onetime ally Karen Bass
item.description: Raman would immediately pose a formidable challenge to Bass. She was the first council member to be elected with support from the Democratic Socialists of America.

item.title: Who is running for L.A. mayor? Here's the list
item.description: The ballot is now finalized (at least for now) in what is shaping up to be a dramatic 2026 race for L.A. mayor.

item.title: New twist in mayor's race makes election a referendum on L.A.’s future
item.description: L.A. Mayor Karen Bass won't have big-name opposition, but has she earned a second term?
